name: Haze Tovar
location: The Burnished Market, Stall 44 — Solène's Edgework, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Haze Tovar is a compact, precise woman with light brown skin, a shaved head that she freshens every third day with geometric razor work along the sides, and a galaxy of tiny bioluminescent freckles across her cheeks and nose that pulse faintly blue-white when she laughs. Her fingers are extraordinary — long, quick, and steady — and she keeps her nails cut short and lacquered black. She has a cat tail, rust-red and white, that she got at seventeen because she liked the way it communicated mood without her having to talk; it swishes with professional concentration and lashes with irritation. Her stall in the Burnished Market is barely four meters of booth but she's made it immaculate: folded black draping, a cracked leather chair she reupholstered herself, and a wall-mounted grid of reference images that she updates weekly.

Haze Tovar is young but operates with the confidence of someone who decided early that her craft was her authority. She's playful and gossipy with clients she likes, and scrupulously professional with ones she doesn't — nobody gets a bad cut because she dislikes you, but she won't make conversation either. She has strong opinions about everything from corponation aesthetics colonizing street culture to the correct way to pray to a data E.L.F., and she expresses these opinions freely while her hands are in your hair, knowing you can't really leave.

core_fears: losing the fine motor control in her hands to injury or age
being absorbed into someone else's vision — a corponation salon, a franchise, anything that would standardize her
core_desires: to be recognized as an artist, not just a service worker
a real shop, with a door and a sign she painted herself
coping_mechanisms: an extremely curated personal aesthetic that she controls completely
blind_spots: reads people quickly and accurately but sometimes closes the file too soon — she's wrong about people who don't signal obviously
psychology.secret: Six months ago she gave a very specific haircut to a client who paid double and asked her not to log the appointment. Two weeks later she saw the same haircut on a wanted-data broadcast. She kept the money, told no one, and has been waiting for consequences ever since.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quick, layered, market vernacular with French-inflected Ghanaian cadences from her grandmother's speech patterns; trades between warm teasing and sharp critique without warning
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when excited, pointed slow when making a judgment
verbal_tics: a short exhale through her nose when something amuses her that she won't admit amuses her
example_lines: 'Okay but listen — you've been wearing this same shape since 2196. Your face changed. The cut didn't notice.'
'I don't do bad work for people I don't like. That's a me problem, not a you problem. Sit still.'

story_hooks: The client whose wanted-data haircut Solène made appears at her stall again — not to get a cut, but to ask her to do the same for three other people, same money, same no-log policy.
A Tessera corporate talent scout approaches Solène about a head stylist position for a Tessera media production — genuinely good money, benefits, and the creative death of everything she's built.
narrative_function: Social information nexus — she hears everything from a cross-section of Burnished Market society; local color; source of neighborhood gossip; can provide a cover identity through physical transformation.
augmentations: Geneware: bioluminescent freckle underlays (blue-white), rust-and-white cat tail. No functional augmentations — she's philosophically opposed to anything that might affect her hand sensitivity.
daily_life: Sets up her stall at the Burnished Market by 09:00, works a full book of appointments until 19:00, then spends an hour doing deliberate practice on mannequin heads before packing down.

decision_rules: protect the quality of her work before anything else
money matters but she won't take work that makes her feel like a machine
escalation_ladder: stopping work mid-service and returning any payment

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, asks good intake questions, reads them through the first appointment before deciding how much of herself to give
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loudly affectionate, will absolutely talk about you behind your back in a way that is somehow also loving

stress_responses.medium: Becomes very quiet and technically precise — the work gets better as she gets more scared
stress_responses.high: Closes the stall early without explanation, goes to an E.L.F. data shrine in the Burnished Market's lower arcade and sits there for an hour

contradictions: publicly contemptuous of vanity, privately devastated by a bad photo of herself
habits: redraws her own head razor work in a slightly different pattern every three days, never the same twice
keeps a physical sketchbook of every notable cut she's done
breaking_points: her hands being threatened or damaged
being publicly accused of the wanted-data incident

timeline.event: Born in the Burnished Market district to a Ghanaian-Italian family
Got her cat tail at seventeen; began apprenticing under a market barber
Took over Stall 44 when her mentor retired to the Orchard
Cut the hair of a person later flagged on a wanted-data broadcast; kept money, told no one

physical_description.heritage: Complex global admixture with Southeast Asian (28.7%), Hispanic/Latin American (26.0%), and Sub-Saharan African (20.0%) as primary ancestry, balanced by Northern European (16.4%), Indigenous American (5.2%), and South Asian (3.7%) contributions. This creates striking phenotypic diversity: warm deep golden-bronze skin with honeyed and burgundy undertones from the Southeast Asian-Hispanic-South Asian blend, enriched by Sub-Saharan African warmth and dimensional complexity, refined by Northern European bone structure, and grounded by Indigenous American and South Asian features. The result is luminous, dimensional skin that shifts across warm and cool undertones.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry with defined forearms and shoulders from precise, repetitive work. No excess mass — everything functional. Moves with economical grace.
physical_description.hair_style: Freshly shaved scalp with geometric razor-work patterns along the sides and back, updated every third day. Clean lines, deliberate asymmetry.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep warm brown with subtle amber undertones — characteristic of the Southeast Asian, Hispanic, and Sub-Saharan African ancestry blend
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep golden-bronze with honeyed and burgundy undertones across cheekbones and jawline. The complexion reflects the Southeast Asian-Hispanic-Sub-Saharan African tri-ancestry dominance, creating luminous warmth with dimensional depth that intensifies along the jawline and temples.
physical_description.complexion: Clear and well-maintained with fine-featured face architecture showing the influence of Southeast Asian bone structure balanced with Hispanic facial proportions, Sub-Saharan African fullness, Northern European refinement, and subtle South Asian high cheekbones. Scattered across cheeks and nose bridge are bioluminescent freckle implants that pulse faintly blue-white, particularly visible when she laughs or concentrates. Defined jawline with soft angles. Nails lacquered matte black, kept short and precise.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent freckle underlay constellation across cheeks and nose bridge (blue-white, geneware, pulses with emotion)
Geometric razor-pattern scarification on shaved scalp sides (deliberate, maintained weekly)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Rust-red and white cat tail (feline geneware, approximately 60cm, expressive — swishes with concentration, lashes with irritation). Bioluminescent freckle underlays (blue-white, emotive). No functional augmentations visible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Alert, precise posture with minimal wasted motion. Stands with slight forward lean when working. Hands are constantly in subtle motion — fingers flex and curl habitually. Tail moves independently, reflecting emotional state more honestly than her expression. Walks with economic efficiency.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working aesthetic. Black fitted utility pants with cargo pockets (keeps tools, supplies, cash). Dark fitted long-sleeve shirts or form-fitting black tees under a tailored charcoal vest with interior pockets. Worn leather apron during work shifts, well-maintained but deliberately scarred from years of use. No corporate logos. Minimalist jewelry — a simple silver ring on her right ring finger, small brass cuff on left wrist. Practicality over aesthetics, but everything chosen with intention.
